name: Fists of Amber
body:
Your claws or fists are coated in amber, allowing you to strike with the power of nature.

Prerequisites: Plant Type, Oozing Sap

Benefit: Your natural attacks are treated as magical for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction.

Dwellers in Dream: The Briarborn. Copyright, January 27, 2013, Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian “Necroblivion” Berg, Richard “AWizardInDallas” Hunt
